modules.name: Clock
modules.description: Digital clock and date. The simplest Orbis module – use it as a reference.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Todo
modules.description: Lists and tasks with due dates. A widget per list plus a full page.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Weather
modules.description: Current conditions and forecast from Open-Meteo. No API key needed.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Calendar
modules.description: Your calendars in one place: ICS feeds and CalDAV accounts (Google, iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail, Radicale …).
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Media
modules.description: Spotify (and Home Assistant media players: Sonos, Chromecast, Kodi, …) on your dashboard: now playing, controls, device picker, search. Any browser tab can become a Spotify Connect speaker.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Home Assistant
modules.description: Your Home Assistant entities as widgets: switches, lights, sensors, climate, scenes. Live over the HA websocket. Also publishes orbis itself to HA over MQTT (next event, open tasks, focus switch).
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Notes
modules.description: Plain notes with a little markdown. A pinned note on the dashboard, a page to write.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Countdown
modules.description: Big number counting down to a date: vacation, birthday, deadline. Client-only, one widget per countdown.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Hub status
modules.description: What the hub itself is doing: cpu, memory, disk, uptime, database size, loaded modules, connected clients.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Habits
modules.description: Daily habits with streaks. Tick today in the widget, see the month grid per habit on the page.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Bookmarks
modules.description: A start page: links with icons, in groups. Favicons fetched by the hub, no third-party services.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Focus timer
modules.description: Pomodoro-style focus timer. State lives on the hub, so it keeps running across devices and reloads.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Birthdays
modules.description: People and their dates. Who is up next, how old they turn, a note so you remember the tea they like.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Feeds
modules.description: RSS / Atom headlines next to your weather. A few feeds, a widget with the latest, a page to skim and mark read.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Shopping list
modules.description: Shared shopping list: quick add, quantities, aisles, tap to check off in the store, bought items come back next time.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Shelly
modules.description: Shelly relays and plugs straight over the local network, no cloud, no Home Assistant. Gen2+ RPC (Plus / Pro / Mini), Gen1 basic.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Departures
modules.description: Next departures from a stop near you. Germany first (DB / HAFAS via transport.rest, no key); other providers can be added.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Meal plan
modules.description: Week grid for lunch and dinner, a recipe box with url import (schema.org json-ld, covers most food blogs), and 'put this week's ingredients on the shopping list'.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Finance
modules.description: Not a budgeting app. Account balances you type in, a few recurring costs, and the one number you actually want: what's left this month.
modules.author: orbis

modules.name: Fitness
modules.description: Last workouts and weekly distance. Pulls from Strava, or takes anything you post to it (Apple Health via a Shortcut, Garmin exports, a curl from your watch script).
modules.author: orbis
